reader.notes: A literal or fixed-size item folds at bind time to its size (ItemLength.Positions / the literal's length); a reference-modified argument takes the runtime length of the substring. Binary and packed items answer their storage size, the implementor's choice the USAGE clause leaves open. No edition switch touches the value.

refuter.evidence: Probe rlen1.cob at --std 85 (runs/rlen1-001): 66 RENAMES R1A THRU R1B 10 (4 + S9(5) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE 6), RENAMES R1B THRU R1C 9, RENAMES single item 3; PPP99 2; 9(5) BLANK WHEN ZERO 5; +ZZ,ZZ9.99 10; continued 60-character nonnumeric literal 60; FD record X(40) 40; ODO element 5. Group X + S9(9) COMP SYNCHRONIZED answers 5: the 1985 SYNCHRONIZED clause leaves implicit FILLER to the implementor and docs/conformance/7/DOC-A.1-195.md and DOC-A.1-197.md document no alignment and no implicit FILLER, so 5 is the group's size in character positions.
